title: materialDefinitionInfo
description: Material information describes how a feature or a set of features is to be rendered, including shading and color. The following table provides the set of attributes and parameters for the `type`: `standard` material. Part of [sharedResource](sharedResource.cmn.md) that is deprecated with 1.7.

name.description: A name for the material as assigned in the creating application.

type.description: Indicates the material type, chosen from the supported values. Possible values are: `standard`water`billboard`leafcard`reference`

$ref.description: The href that resolves to the shared resource bundle in which the material definition is contained.
